color.note: Ink is the home theme. Paper is the same system printed: use it for documents and anywhere a light page is wanted. Signal fills never change between themes; text and marks use the -text tokens, which do.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page, slide and screen background. Ink is a green-tinted black, Paper is warm cream. Never pure black or white.

tokens.name: desk
tokens.usage: The surface panels sit on: slide letterbox, the area around a document page, a canvas behind collaged cards. In Paper it doubles as the tan card colour. Only `ink` text reads on it.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on ground: cards, code blocks, inputs, glyph tiles.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of panel, open glyph tiles, a second layer inside a panel.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Unlit pixels: empty meter cells, matrix background, arcs. Decorative only; never text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative: does not meet 3:1, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, tab outlines, table header rules, drawn diagram strokes. At least 3:1 on ground, panel and panel-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and glyphs on ground, desk, panel and panel-2 (11:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels, the second line of a headline. On ground, panel and panel-2 only; not on desk.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative pixels and dots in fields (dither terrain, scattered dots). Never text or meaningful marks.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Signal fill: section slabs, the left half of a split slide, shard polygons, the signal button. Text on it is `on-blue`.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Signal fill and the system's lead colour: primary button, section slabs, filled glyph tiles, live pixels. Text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Signal fill: scatter fields, risk states, a filled glyph tile. Text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Signal fill, used sparingly: one glyph tile, a highlight cell, watch states. Text on it is `on-signal`.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Collage-only fill: the halftone card. Never a state, never a button.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on green, orange, yellow and lilac fills (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-blue
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on a blue fill (4.6:1).

tokens.name: blue-wash
tokens.usage: Translucent blue region in diagrams (the lower band of a mesh), selected table rows.

tokens.name: green-wash
tokens.usage: Translucent green highlight: a marked code line, a hovered row in Ink.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text or a meaningful mark (pip, meter cell, open glyph) on ground, panel and panel-2.

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green as text or a meaningful mark on ground, panel and panel-2. In Ink it is the signal green itself.

tokens.name: orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange as text or a meaningful mark on ground, panel and panel-2: error messages, risk pips.

tokens.name: yellow-text
tokens.usage: Yellow as text or a meaningful mark on ground, panel and panel-2.

tokens.name: lilac-text
tokens.usage: Lilac as a mark on ground, panel and panel-2, for the rare chart that needs a fifth series.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour; the ring itself is the `focus-ring` shadow.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in running text, always underlined.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Status fill for done, passing, fixed. Always paired with a word (a Tag), never colour alone.

tokens.name: watch
tokens.usage: Status fill for pending, needs a look. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: risk
tokens.usage: Status fill for failing, at risk, error. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Status fill for neutral information and in-progress. Always paired with a word.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Regular weight, tight leading, negative tracking. Bitfield never shouts with bold; size does the work.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per view: a web hero or a slide cover headline.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section titles, statement slides, document cover titles.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, document H2, app screen titles.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.sample: Twelve weeks of engine data, ranked by risk.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and the muted second line under a headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sensors log temperature, pressure and vibration every two seconds.
styles.usage: Running text in apps and on the web.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Updated 2 minutes ago by the duty engineer.
styles.usage: Dense UI, helper text, table cells.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Mono carries labels, indexes, codes and data. Labels are uppercase (bundle.css sets it on .label and .label-lg).

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Glyph tile captions, navigation, button text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Kickers, tabs, tags, table headers, metadata.

spacing.note: 4px base, but layouts move in 8px pixels. Prefer the even steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Pip-to-label gap, tag inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows, tab padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding (compact), button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Web page section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Slide margin at 1920 wide; hero padding.

radius.note: Square. Corners only soften at the scale of a single pixel.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, slides, glyph tiles, images. The default.

tokens.name: radius-ctl
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-pixel
tokens.usage: One pixel unit inside a glyph or matrix (2px on an 8px cell).

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Dots in halftone and scatter fields, the only round things.

grid.note: The Bitfield unit. Glyphs are 9 x 9 cells; fields and meters snap to it.

tokens.name: pixel-sm
tokens.usage: Dither and noise cells.

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: Glyph cells, matrix cells, dot pitch in UI.

tokens.name: pixel-lg
tokens.usage: Meter cells at display size, field pitch on slides.

tokens.name: dur-step
tokens.usage: One frame of a stepped pixel animation.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Panels sliding in, mask reveals.

tokens.name: dur-push
tokens.usage: Scene-to-scene push between slides or views.

tokens.name: ease-push
tokens.usage: Push transitions: leaves fast, lands hard.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: panels, masks, toasts.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Pixel fields lighting up cell by cell.

shadow.note: No elevation shadows. Layers are told apart by fill and a hairline, the way paper cards are on a desk.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px ground gap, then 2px of solid focus colour.
